key_finding: No single cohort fully meets the t016 spec. UK Biobank is the admissible primary vehicle (population, low-collider, pre-infection baseline, questionnaire menopause staging, usable testosterone/SHBG) with the decisive limitation that baseline oestradiol is censored by a 175 pmol/L assay floor; menopause exposure must therefore rest on questionnaire reproductive staging (reinforcing t020). Triangulate with All of Us / Lifelines / Generation Scotland; ONS-CIS and N3C are low-exposure triangulation only. No prior study has run this causal analysis with a pre-infection baseline in UKB or Lifelines.
